chats.answer:
If you're looking for the best all-in-one solar inverter and battery system, I'd focus on systems that combine a hybrid inverter, lithium battery storage, solar charging, and backup power capabilities.

The best choice depends on whether you're powering an entire house, building an off-grid system, or looking for a more affordable DIY setup.

For a home installation in the US, my top brands to compare are Tesla, EG4, EcoFlow, and FranklinWH.

Best all-in-one inverter and battery systems (2026)
Shop

1. Tesla Powerwall 3 — Best overall

13.5 kWh battery | 11.5 kW inverter

Integrated solar inverter and battery in one enclosure. Best for professionally installed home solar and backup.

10-year warranty

Shop

2. EG4 FlexBOSS21 with PowerPro battery — Best value

14.3 kWh battery | 12 kW battery output inverter

Good for DIY-friendly installations, off-grid systems, and expandable storage. Inverter and battery are separate enclosures.

Shop

3. EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra — Best modular system

6.1 kWh starting battery | 7.2 kW inverter

Stackable battery system with solar input and 120/240V output. Easier to relocate than a permanently mounted home battery.

Listed package from $5,143.00; configuration varies

Shop

4. FranklinWH aPower 2 — Best for larger storage

15 kWh battery | 10 kW continuous power

Strong option for whole-home backup and generator integration, with a 15-year warranty.

These specifications are supported by 2026 home battery comparisons.
